figures.caption: Corruption and learned reverse generation. Rightward q arrows specify forward corruption; leftward pθ arrows denote learned reverse updates. Continuous-valued noise and categorical MASK are different state spaces. Masked diffusion is one discrete construction, not a definition of every diffusion model. Values and tokens are conceptual illustrations, not measurements. Flow matching is related but is not the identical training objective. [1P][FACT] D01–D07; drawing [ILLUSTRATIVE].
figures.alt_text: Two lanes run left to right from clean data through partial corruption to a prior. Continuous values occupy the top lane and text tokens with MASK occupy the lower lane. Black forward arrows q point right. Separate orange learned reverse arrows p theta point left. Notes separate training corruption, reverse sampling and flow matching.

figures.caption: Inference order, cache validity and output commitment. Autoregressive decoding extends a causal prefix; the displayed AR snapshots include processing of the newest accepted token before its K/V are shown as finalized. The illustrated full-canvas masked sampler accepts positions out of order but still recomputes bidirectional states. The block-causal design refines a mutable block before extending the immutable prefix. Loops denote repeated evaluations, not fixed counts or proportional time. Accepted token IDs do not by themselves establish reusable K/V. Approximate cache, editing and renoising implementations require their own policies. [1P][FACT] D08,D11–D15,D18,D24–D26; resource interpretation [DERIVED] D33–D34.
figures.alt_text: Three rows compare inference snapshots. AR grows A, then AB, then ABC; hyphens indicate inactive future positions. The masked canvas starts with hatched question marks, accepts A and C together, then ABCD; a dashed outline marks recomputed output representations, not editable IDs. The block-causal row refines an active two-position block and then advances. Solid brackets below cells identify finalized reusable prefix state. Repeat loops attach to unresolved intermediate regions, not final output. Fixed IDs alone do not guarantee invariant K/V; block-prefix reuse needs a causal boundary and finalization.
